claim: COVID-19 had caused zero deaths in people under 20.
justification: The high-confidence evidence (confidence=0.85) from the knowledge-only reasoner states that the CDC documented COVID-19 deaths in individuals under 20 by mid-2020, corroborated by external reports like NBC News detailing 121 deaths. This directly refutes the claim of zero deaths as of October 2020. Low-confidence evidence from the retrieval-based fact-checker supporting the claim is discounted because assessments indicate it is contradicted by established knowledge.
